title: Degree-zero finite-duality counit and algebra-action compatibility
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be finite between Noetherian schemes, $A=f_*\mathcal O_X$ finite locally free, and $L$ invertible. Fix $R:D_{QCoh}(X)\to D_{QCoh}(Y)$ with comparison to $Rf_*$ and right adjoint $a$, $K\simeq L[0]$, a quasi-coherent module $M$, $e_0:M[0]\simeq aK$, and the canonical right-derived-unit comparison $c:(f_*M)[0]\simeq Rf_*(M[0])$. Then there exist $e:f_*M\simeq\mathcal Hom(A,L)$ and $\epsilon:f_*M\to L$ such that $\epsilon[0]$ equals c followed by $Rf_*(e_0)$, the functor comparison, the adjunction counit and $K\simeq L[0]$. On every open U, $\epsilon(\omega)=e(\omega)(1)$ and $e(a\omega)(b)=e(\omega)(ab)$ for actual sections of $\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}U)$. This assumes rather than constructs M, e0 and c; it does not assert the final arbitrary-section evaluation identity.

proof.text: Use the affine underived sheaf-Hom adjunction, whose A-valued Hom carries precomposition by multiplication and evaluates its counit at one. The locally finite free dual of A is locally finite free. Canonical evaluation identifies tensor by the dual with Hom(A,-), hence Hom is exact. Restriction of scalars is exact and conservative, so the A-valued Hom functor is exact too.

Derive this exact Hom model with its canonical single-complex comparison, retaining evaluation and the action. The finite affine derived equivalence identifies it with the right adjoint on D_QCoh at K=L[0]. Uniqueness of right adjoints preserves counits, encoded by the finite-duality equations and the affine derived-adjunction counit equation. Normalize the Hom-from-unit identification to actual evaluation, rather than an arbitrary automorphism.

Use the canonical affine comparison for M and naturality along e0. Both sides of the A-linear derived identification are now in degree zero. Full faithfulness of singleFunctor in the A-module category lifts it to an A-linear isomorphism; after restriction this is e. Lift the counit to epsilon. The derived counit identity gives the displayed singleFunctor equation.

The canonical exact model retains the underived evaluation formula and action formula on each open. Specialize the Over(U) precomposition formula from sheafHom_affine_rightAdjoint to the identity inclusion to obtain Phi(a omega)(b)=Phi(omega)(ab). No division, nonzero rank, nonempty open or cancellation is needed.
